discoverySuccessorContract.predecessorOwnershipRule: a move that begins in lookbehind remains owned by the predecessor chunk

residualDiscoveryRisks.mitigation: The model selects an actual bounded final row rather than performing requested-token arithmetic; per-row token counts and the manual disclose the unchanged minimum; deterministic validation rejects reversed or short windows; and the production checkpoint stops on any invalid context without retry.

costBoundary.estimateBasis: Conservatively scaled from the realized v2.1.3 36-context discovery run (18.58 wall minutes and 62.01 aggregate model minutes), with extra upper-bound allowance for this production checkpoint's two larger Debate 167 copied inputs; subscription use has no direct incremental API charge.
